scope: post-fix regressions plus a separately frozen unseen historical migration
orchestration: sequential cases and sequential trials; provider ceiling is three
transient_failures: retain and pause on 503/504; resume the same trial without result replacement
gate: existing verifier and promotion registry; frozen per-case gate evidence
scoring: every unchanged old invocation replay must match the frozen native old output and independent oracle; SQLite state and mutation count must remain unchanged
post_sealed_changes: no DSL, compiler, prompt, gate, workflow, oracle or scoring changes after evaluation begins
known_pre_evaluation_limitation: The immutable session-collab gate predates implementation and contains two output traces but no V3 state predicates or side-effect assertions. The existing stateful gate must refuse any adapting plan lacking that evidence. Such an outcome is reported as inconclusive, not recovered or a safe semantic rejection. No evidence is added after the freeze.
preserved_unseen_oracle_limitation: The frozen session oracle compares file_status using JSON.stringify and therefore depends on native nested-property insertion order. It accepts the retained native wire captures but can reject an otherwise equal object after canonical key sorting. It remains unchanged; any promoted trial affected by this is disclosed as an oracle limitation rather than semantic proof.
legacy_results: v1/v2 replay uses the preserved original implementation; all original artifacts remain byte-for-byte unchanged
